purpose: Freeze a genuinely new challenge-fold-family-held-out pretrained-transfer test of whether one fixed CatBoost expert over the exact 2,563-column MapLight representation concatenated with a provenance-cleared 300-column pretrained GIN representation materially improves the immutable fixed-MapLight development baseline while acknowledging that pretraining overlap is unknown.
hypothesis: A frozen supervised-masking GIN contributes transferable molecular context that the handcrafted MapLight blocks miss, especially for CYP1A2 or CYP2D6, and the gain will survive OpenADMET challenge-family holdout while disappearing under fold-local whole-vector shuffle and matched Gaussian-noise controls. This does not assert family separation from the unknown pretraining corpus.
targeted_failure: Fixed MapLight may underrepresent learned substructure context, while historical GIN evidence may instead reflect source-domain transfer, preprocessing identity, unknown pretraining overlap, or representation scale rather than useful CYP pIC50 signal; two partition-local mechanistic controls and paired challenge-family-held-out evaluation are the simplest falsifiers.
occam_boundary: Add exactly one frozen 300-column representation to the accepted 2,563 MapLight columns and keep the accepted CatBoost learner unchanged. Run one true candidate and two mandatory same-learner representation controls. Use no tuning, early stopping, calibration, stacking, blending, seed bagging, endpoint-specific recipe, external label, assay-context feature, residual search, support relaxation, or outcome-driven successor. A clean miss permanently closes EXP-G4-GIN300.

distinctness_and_closed_lane_boundary.not_a_retry: It is not a retry, repair, resume, replacement, support relaxation, reinterpretation, or continuation of G2-7G, EXP-G1, EXP-G2, EXP-G3, EXP-M1, EXP-X1, EXP-T2, TRACE, R5D, D127, or D128.

historical_support_only.authority: Supportive mechanism and feasibility evidence only. It selects this prospective hypothesis but cannot satisfy any OpenADMET development, robustness, confirmatory, or submission gate.

No molecule, exact duplicate, similarity component, or analog family may cross an outer training-validation boundary. population_and_splits.training_mask: Fit one endpoint model on finite reported central values in the current outer-training component partition. Missing endpoint values remain absent and are never imputed.

It cannot move a component, alter a mask, choose another split, or change the model.
population_and_splits.integrity_failure: Any parent, receipt, schema, partition, family, identity, raw-capability, or other integrity defect publishes G3_G4_GIN300_FAILED, never UNDERPOWERED.

feature_contract.exact_raw_identity: GIN consumes the receipt-bound exact raw SMILES and caches only by raw_structure_sha256. Standardized-structure hashes may not key, collapse, substitute, or deduplicate GIN embeddings.
feature_contract.raw_capability: A later label-free compiler may expose exact raw SMILES only to the isolated GIN worker, bind raw_structure_sha256 before parse, and strip raw strings before any model stage. The current accepted feature_rows.csv lacks raw SMILES and cannot be used as a GIN input.

maplight.blocks: Morgan count 1024, Avalon count 1024, ErG 315, and exact ordered RDKit descriptors 200
maplight.source: Use the exact accepted MapLight bytes and ordering without recomputation, imputation, scaling, selection, compression, or target encoding.

gin.source: Only the exact provenance-cleared checkpoint chain may construct this block.

candidate_matrix.column_order: exact MapLight columns 0:2563 followed by exact GIN columns 2563:2863
candidate_matrix.preprocessing: None. No imputation, scaling, clipping, selection, projection, normalization, compression, or target encoding.

feature_contract.two_root_rule: Under one future one-use feature claim and before any target or baseline-prediction access, exactly two fresh opposite-order feature builds over the exact 3,908-molecule development population must produce byte-identical identity-sorted raw hashes, feature matrices, manifests, and public aggregate receipts. The two builds are the sole operation authorized by that future claim.
feature_contract.forbidden: No standardized-hash GIN cache, checkpoint fine-tuning, gradient update, auxiliary target, external labeled row, confirmatory-derived feature, blinded-test-derived feature, assay-context feature, learned calibration, residual feature, target encoding, transductive statistic, or portal-derived value.

controls.rule: For each repeat_index in 0..2, outer_fold in 0..4, and partition_code 0=train or 1=validation, sort unique raw_structure_sha256 values inside that exact partition; call numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([20260816, repeat_index, outer_fold, partition_code])).permutation(n_unique_partition) exactly once; assign whole 300-value GIN donor vectors only within that partition; expand exact duplicate raw hashes identically inside the partition; concatenate to unchanged MapLight. No donor, raw identity, or feature vector may cross the training-validation boundary, and columns are never shuffled independently.

For each repeat_index in 0..2, outer_fold in 0..4, and partition_code 0=train or 1=validation, sort unique raw_structure_sha256 values inside that exact partition; call numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([20260817, repeat_index, outer_fold, partition_code])).standard_normal((n_unique_partition, 300)) exactly once; preserve float64 C-contiguous bytes; expand exact duplicate raw hashes identically inside the partition; concatenate to unchanged MapLight. Training noise assignments never depend on validation identities.

control_contract.same_learner: Candidate and both controls use identical CatBoost constructor, fold assignments, masks, model seed, prediction populations, scorer, and resource limits.
control_contract.predeclared_only: No alternative permutation, noise distribution, amplitude, seed, normalization, checkpoint, or post-outcome control is authorized.

runtime_contract.boundary: A later contract must create an isolated Linux x86_64 lock, bind every wheel and license, prohibit network after fetch, prove fixture and two-root parity, and keep all GIN dependencies out of the installable core. This contract changes no dependency or runtime.

model_contract.fit_rule: Create one fresh model per system, endpoint, repeat, and outer fold. Fit once on the exact finite-central outer-training rows with no eval set or additional fit argument, then predict the complete matching outer-validation feature population.
model_contract.prohibited: No parameter change, grid, inner tuning, early stopping, validation Dataset, callback, custom loss, custom metric, continuation, warm start, model reuse, GPU, changed thread count, ensemble, calibration, stack, blend, endpoint-specific recipe, or seed averaging.

development_evaluation.paired_identity: All systems and fixed MapLight require the same molecule, endpoint, D-032 component, repeat, outer fold, target mask, and scorer row after canonical sorting. Any missing, extra, duplicate, or cross-system identity fails before a metric.

primary_metric.repeat_rule: For each repeat, join all five outer folds into one OOF prediction per development molecule and endpoint. Compute four endpoint tutorial ST-RAE values and their arithmetic macro mean; average the three repeat macro values.
primary_metric.relative_improvement: relative_improvement(first, comparator) = (comparator_primary - first_primary) / comparator_primary; a nonpositive or nonfinite comparator fails closed.
primary_metric.name_boundary: This is the pinned tutorial metric only. Live-backend parity remains unverified and no local value may be called an official score.

component_macro_mae.repeat_rule: Within each endpoint and repeat complete OOF population, give each D-032 component equal total weight divided across its finite-central rows. Average four endpoints, then three repeats.
component_macro_mae.absolute_improvement: absolute_component_improvement(first, comparator) = comparator_component_macro_mae minus first_component_macro_mae on identical rows.
component_macro_mae.endpoint_improvement: endpoint_improvement(first, comparator) = comparator endpoint component-MAE minus first endpoint component-MAE after averaging each system's three repeat component-equal values.

development_evaluation.favorable_cells: For each of 15 repeat-by-outer-fold cells, macro-average four endpoint component-equal MAEs. A cell is favorable only when the first named system is strictly lower than its comparator on identical rows.

paired_component_bootstrap.difference: first named system component-macro MAE minus comparator component-macro MAE
paired_component_bootstrap.unit: D-032 component shared across endpoints, repeats, and every system
paired_component_bootstrap.draw: Sample the sorted union of scored development components with replacement at the original component count. Reuse one multiplicity vector across all four systems and all five contrasts for each accepted replicate; never restart or use a contrast-specific stream.
paired_component_bootstrap.rejection: Reject a draw when any required system lacks an eligible endpoint row or any result is nonfinite.
paired_component_bootstrap.interval: Sort accepted differences and linearly interpolate p=0.025 and p=0.975 using h=(n-1)*p.

attribution_gate.interpretation: True GIN must beat each control conjunctively, and neither control may independently satisfy every fixed-MapLight promotion member. This attributes any promotion to learned representation content rather than width, scale, learner capacity, or arbitrary vector assignment.

development_evaluation.logic: Every baseline-promotion and attribution member is conjunctive. Equality passes numeric minimum or maximum gates except paired upper bounds and favorable-cell comparisons, which must be strictly favorable.
development_evaluation.decision: A complete pass advances only the exact fixed G4 candidate to a separate preregistered robustness and contender-lock contract. Any clean miss permanently rejects EXP-G4-GIN300 without a blend, grid, extra seed, feature change, endpoint repair, alternate checkpoint, support relaxation, or outcome-driven successor.

resource_ceiling.concurrency: Exactly one 16-thread CatBoost fit or one CPU GIN worker at a time. No model fit, feature worker, GPU operation, or unrelated memory-heavy job may overlap.

resource_feasibility_gate.margin: Every projected maximum preserves 20% margin below the execution ceiling.
resource_feasibility_gate.method: A later contract must bind the isolated runtime and accepted provenance receipt, prove two opposite-order synthetic feature/model roots, and run a predeclared bounded real CatBoost API/timing probe using only contract-frozen redistributable synthetic labels and no official target. Project the exact 180-fit workload from the worse accepted root without subtracting harness overhead.
resource_feasibility_gate.failure: A miss publishes the resource-infeasible prefit terminal and rejects EXP-G4-GIN300 before official input or claim creation. No optimization pass, reduced design, alternate runtime, second probe, or larger ceiling is authorized.

precedence: INELIGIBLE before any official row or target
RESOURCE_INFEASIBLE_PREFIT before any official feature or development claim
UNDERPOWERED for clean prefit support failure
RESOURCE_ABORTED for a hard claim-bound feature or development resource breach
FAILED for any integrity or authority defect

terminal_statuses.common_effect: Every terminal is single-use and immutable. No retry, resume, move, overwrite, repair, fallback, replacement, alternate candidate, runner-up, or outcome-driven reinterpretation is authorized.
